_note: Starting points, not templates. Pick one, then make it specific to the product. Fonts are on Google Fonts. Look up the real reference products before designing.

directions.name: Field Notebook
directions.layout: Single reading column with a margin rail for notes. Results read like annotated pages, not panels.
directions.signature: Marginalia: short hand-style callouts attached to results with a thin leader line.
directions.avoid: Card grids, drop shadows, icon-in-circle bullets.

directions.name: Civic Ledger
directions.layout: Ruled newspaper columns with a dateline. One dominant figure per screen, supporting detail in narrow columns.
directions.signature: Oversized tabular numerals with hairline rules and a red verdict stamp.
directions.avoid: Dashboards of equal tiles, gradient fills, rounded pills.

directions.name: Clinical Calm
directions.layout: Large status banner on top, one clear next step below, details collapsed. Tap targets 48px or more.
directions.signature: A single plain-language status sentence at 28px+ that changes colour and wording with the result.
directions.avoid: Small grey text, dense tables, red-green only status.

directions.name: Workshop Orange
directions.layout: Big numeric readouts on a concrete-grey field, hazard-stripe dividers between stages, checklist-style steps.
directions.signature: Stencil section labels and a hazard-stripe bar that fills as the job progresses.
directions.avoid: Thin light fonts, pastel colours, soft shadows.

directions.name: Pastel Playground
directions.layout: Chunky sticker-like blocks at slight angles, one big friendly action per screen, generous spacing.
directions.signature: Sticker buttons that squash on press and a mascot-free celebratory moment on success.
directions.avoid: Corporate blue, small type, dense forms.

directions.name: Museum Label
directions.layout: Wide margins, objects shown large with small wall-label captions beside them, numbered plates.
directions.signature: Wall-label captions (title, year, one sentence) attached to every result.

directions.name: Amber Terminal
directions.layout: Command-first: one input, streaming output, results as structured blocks. Mono only for code and data, a real text face for everything else.
directions.signature: Output blocks that show the exact command that produced them, with a copy button.
directions.avoid: Cyan on black, all-caps labels, fake telemetry, snake_case in the UI. Developer tools only.

directions.name: Blueprint Light
directions.layout: Drawing sheet: the work fills the canvas, tools sit in a slim title-block strip, annotations use dimension lines.
directions.signature: Dimension lines and numbered callouts drawn on top of the user's own content.

directions.name: Soft Utility
directions.layout: Mobile-first: bottom sheet for the main action, thumb-reach controls, big readable numbers.
directions.signature: A single oversized number or answer at the top of every screen, with the explanation below it.

directions.name: Risograph Zine
directions.layout: Two-colour overprint blocks with slight misregistration, collage spacing, stamp-style buttons.
directions.signature: Halftone shadows and an offset second colour on every headline.

directions.name: Swiss Signal
directions.layout: Strict grid, one metric per screen section, thin rules instead of boxes, tabular numerals.
directions.signature: One signal colour used only for the thing that needs attention, everything else in ink and grey.
directions.avoid: Rainbow charts, KPI card grids, drop shadows.

directions.name: Night Market
directions.layout: Warm dark ground with paper-coloured cards cut like signs; photography or illustration leads.
directions.signature: Paper-cut layered headers with a soft lantern glow behind the primary action.
directions.avoid: Cyan, neon, mono type, cold greys.

directions.name: Penny Dreadful
directions.layout: Broadsheet page with woodcut borders, engraved illustration blocks, ornamental dividers.
directions.signature: Woodcut frame around the main result and a wax-seal confirmation.
directions.avoid: Neon glows, pumpkin emoji, dripping-font clichés.

directions.name: Greenhouse
directions.layout: Soft sections divided by organic edges, line illustrations of plants as empty states, large calm numbers.
directions.signature: A small line-drawn plant that grows or wilts with the user's result.
directions.avoid: Stock leaf icons, neon green, harsh black.

directions.name: Transit Signage
directions.layout: Wayfinding signs: bold black-on-yellow headers, route lines connecting steps, big arrows for the next action.
directions.signature: A route line that runs down the page connecting each step, with a 'you are here' marker.
directions.avoid: Decorative type, soft colours, hidden navigation.

directions.name: Warm Workbench
directions.layout: Pro-tool layout with a floating tool palette, a layers panel and an inspector, with the canvas dominant. Shortcut hints sit beside the tools.
directions.signature: One orange accent that only ever means 'selected' or 'primary action', and generated output designed in the same warm palette as the tool itself.
directions.avoid: Cyan or purple accents, glow, tiny labels, decorative panels. For real tools only; a tool that does not need a dark canvas should be light.

directions.name: Neo-Brutal Play
directions.layout: Thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, flat saturated blocks, one character at the centre and big labelled buttons below it.
directions.signature: A hand-made character that reacts to every action, with segmented meters instead of thin progress bars.
directions.avoid: Emoji-only buttons with no label, soft shadows, gradients, low-contrast greys.
